messages.author: 1bf41286e5769514
messages.subject: New User - Troubleshooting
parts:
First of all, thank you for making this tool open-source and providing a Wiki for us to follow. MaAsLin seems like a very useful tool for microbiome analysis but I've spent the past several days attempting to get it up and running with little success. I was hoping you could provide some advice on some issues I've come across. Thank you for your time!

1. Galaxy module:
Does the module have an option for random effects?
Is there an option to force predictors?
Is the server secure for data sets with sensitive data?
How long do jobs typically takes (e.g. I have 533 samples & 5 metadata covariates)?

2. Installation in R:
I ran into an error which states MaAsLin was not available for R version 3.4.4. Which R version would you recommend? I'm currently using the install.package() command as I'm not familiar with the R CMD INSTALL method in Windows.

3. Docker - I successfully ran MaAsLin using Docker. However, my p-values and q-values are outside the normal range (e.g. negative or >1). This seems to be an issue previously reported by several users: https://bitbucket.org/biobakery/maaslin/issues/23/error-reading-p-values-when-using-random. Unfortunately, the solution posted in this site did not appear to work for other users and changing the package version in Docker is not quite straightforward to new users such as myself. Do you have any suggestions?





Thanks,
Kyu

messages.author: 1bf41286e5769514
messages.subject: Re: New User - Troubleshooting
parts: Update on question 2. This worked: install.packages("https://bitbucket.org/biobakery/maaslin/downloads/Maaslin_0.0.5.tar.gz", repo=NULL, type="source")
